items.text: MEC (maths, economics, commerce) and CEC (civics, economics, commerce) students can go into commerce, economics, management, law and professional courses, and the real difference between the two groups is how far maths opens statistics, data and quantitative economics.
MEC keeps quantitative economics, statistics and data open more easily; CEC suits law, public policy and social-science routes.
Read the current admission notice for each route before you plan.
